playerAst.rule: Only originally Korean string literals may change in the compared functions. The single session-limit sentence may reorder pure string concatenation with exactly the same camera inputs and identical branch condition. All other AST nodes, identifiers, calls, event names, state strings, numbers and operators must match.

lifecycle.normalization: Only localized accessible video-name values and four UI textContent fields are excluded; timers, Hls settings, source URLs, events, state, cleanup, media attributes and UI visibility remain exact.

scope: Static transition validation only. Historical800observations keep their original hashes, acquisition times, outcomes and measured versions. This report is not a new playback observation, a fresh400camera live audit, or an uptime guarantee. Layout, map presentation, UI event interaction and production playback smoke checks require separate validation.
